design.B: constant series, all samples = 1 (normalizes to the zero patch)
design.tone: sqrt(2) cos(2 pi b t / 32 + phi), explicit phi
design.captured_state: last patch token of the 1280-dim residual stream
design.splice: forward hook replaces the tokenizer output (l=0) or the output of stacked_xf[l-1] (l>=1) with the interpolated full state tensor; tail blocks l+1..20 and the head then run normally
design.band_energy: ||P_b x||^2 / L over an L-sample window

6.note: cos(grad E_b, d) is scale-free: ~1 means the head's band-b read-out direction is aligned with the tone-const difference at the head input, ~0 means orthogonal.  The random control says what a generic direction of the same norm achieves, i.e. whether d is special.

caveats: run A is a unit-power tone, so its revin stats are mu~0, sigma~1 and the raw head output equals the forecast; the constant run has sigma=0, so its head output is renormalised to exactly 1 regardless of the head.  Exp 2 therefore reads *raw* head outputs (pre-revin), pinned at alpha=0 to the B read-out and at alpha=1 to the A read-out.  Exp 1's ratio through the head mixes the head map (1280->1280) with the residual-stream scale, so the behavioural column (band energy / ||yA-yB||) is the ground truth and the block curve the localiser.
